title: After copying/cutting, the tile editor behaves strangely in the "Patterns" section.
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.rc1.official [481f36ed2]

### System information

w11

### Issue description

After copying/cut a map area, it is impossible to draw the selected pattern again. To fix this, you must select a different pattern and then re-select the previous one.

There is a glitch/conflict in the logic here.

If you select an area by pressing 'S', cut and paste it, and then select the pencil to draw a pattern, you won't be able to paint anything. To draw the currently selected pattern, you are forced to select another one and then switch back to the one you wanted.


**Please watch the video for reference.**

In this video, I cut an area of the map and paste it. Then, I select the pencil tool to draw with the selected pattern (the square), but the pencil doesn't draw anything. Clicking on the square pattern again doesn't help either.

Workaround: Select a different pattern and then re-select the square; only then will the pencil paint it.

https://youtu.be/tytab1i7oac


### Steps to reproduce

1. **Define** some patterns.
2. **Create** a simple map.
3. **Press the 'S' key** and select an area.
4. **Copy or cut** the selection.
5. **Paste** it.
6. Now, **try to draw a pattern**: select the pencil tool if it isn't already active. You will notice you cannot paint the pattern; instead, it keeps painting the copied area (if you cut an area, it won't paint anything at all). You won't be able to paint the currently selected pattern until you deselect it by clicking another one and then re-selecting it. After doing this, you can paint the pattern normally.
